releaseNotes: v1.9.6: Background daemon mode (9router-go start/status/stop/restart/logs), a Combos page matched against upstream v0.5.91 in the browser, Codex reset-credit redemption with a confirm-before-spend gate, ZIP backup export/import, and dashboard login-lockout plus remote password rotation fixes. Tool names over 64 chars are now fitted deterministically (MCP namespaced tools were rejected upstream with HTTP 400) and restored on the way back. A 200 carrying no answer now fails over instead of hanging, post-200 stream aborts are reported in-band rather than as a fake finish_reason, and PGO plus connection-pool tuning cut p99 latency 51% at c=100. Pre-release review then found and fixed six more defects that had passed every gate: status/stop/logs were blind to DATA_DIR set in .env (so stop silently failed on every compose deployment), fitted tool names leaked to the client on the Claude TranslateResp lane, the Responses lane built a self-contradictory request so the 64-char fix never actually applied, Codex reset-credit idempotency was empty so double-submit could spend two credits, 'stop' never drained gracefully on Windows (cutting SQLite writes mid-transaction), and a pre-existing send-on-closed-channel data race in usagetracker. Each ships with a mutation-checked regression test. Known follow-ups, deliberately not in this release: self-update can install an unverified binary when the manifest carries no sha256; prerelease tags compare equal to their final release so an RC can be auto-applied.
